svg.font-family: 'Noto Sans SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Source Sans 3', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: A grid of six rows of eight cells. Each row is the same stretch of memory at one tick, holding 3 1 4 1 5 9 2 6, and every row is identical; the rows are labelled t = 0 to t = 5 on the left. In each row one cell is amber: cell 1 at tick 0, moving one cell to the right in each later row, with an arrow between the amber cells of neighbouring rows, a note below saying the arrows are ptr++ at every tick; on the right is the value read at that tick, *ptr = 1, 4, 1, 5, 9, 2.
svg.title: A grid of six rows of eight cells. Each row is the same stretch of memory at one tick, holding 3 1 4 1 5 9 2 6, and every row is identical; the rows are labelled t = 0 to t = 5 on the left. In each row one cell is amber: cell 1 at tick 0, moving one cell to the right in each later row, with an arrow between the amber cells of neighbouring rows, a note below saying the arrows are ptr++ at every tick; on the right is the value read at that tick, *ptr = 1, 4, 1, 5, 9, 2.
